oslogin_enable.description: Enable OS Login to manage SSH keys and sudo access via Google metadata.

ssh_cache_ttl.description: Time (in seconds) to cache SSH public keys before refreshing from metadata. Set to 0 to disable caching.

oslogin_2fa.description: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for sudo commands.

ssh_key_refresh.description: Automatically refresh SSH keys on each login by fetching from instance/project metadata.

ssh_metadata_key.description: Metadata key name where SSH keys are stored (e.g., 'sshKeys' or 'google-ssh-keys').

sudoers_config_path.description: Path to the OS Login sudoers configuration file.

sudo_groups.description: List of groups to map to sudo access. Each entry defines a group name and GID.

gid.description: Unix group ID (GID) to assign to the group.

sync_unix_groups.description: Sync Unix group membership from external directory (e.g., Active Directory or LDAP) via metadata.

sudo_unix_groups.description: List of Unix group names allowed sudo access via OS Login.

import_ssh_keys.description: Import SSH public keys from instance or project metadata.

import_unix_home.description: Import Unix home directory settings (e.g., home directory path, UID) from metadata.

home_dir_base.description: Base path for user home directories (e.g., '/home' or '/users').

default_shell.description: Default login shell for OS Login users.

audit_logging.description: Enable audit logging for OS Login events (e.g., SSH logins, sudo usage).

audit_log_file.description: Path to the OS Login audit log file.

selinux_enable.description: Enable SELinux support for OS Login operations.

pam_session.description: Enable PAM session management (e.g., setting up environment, home dir).

use_login.description: Use /bin/login for SSH sessions (may be needed for certain PAM integrations).
